verdict.rationale: Paddle doesn't ship a native in-dashboard AI-insights feature, but its MCP server explicitly lets connected AI agents 'Generate reports and analyze revenue, refunds, and transaction patterns' and 'Investigate failed payments' against live account data, which delivers a form of AI-generated insight from the user's own Paddle data (paddle-supp-mcp-server, paddle-docs-5). This is agent-mediated via an external client (Claude/Cursor) rather than insights surfaced natively inside Paddle's own UI. Missing for 10: a first-party in-product analytics/insights panel or proactive suggestion feature inside the Paddle dashboard itself, and independent evidence of users actually receiving such insights.
